# Wormifi

> Wormifi is a free pirate treasure worm arena game that runs in any web
> browser - no download, no account, no ads before play. Solo modes (90-second
> rush, endless, practice) work offline once installed; live multiplayer runs
> in server-authoritative rooms with honestly labeled AI backfill. It installs
> to phones without an app store. Cosmetic skins are the only thing ever sold;
> nothing purchasable affects gameplay.

Key facts: one-word brand name "Wormifi" (worm-if-ee), unrelated to Wi-Fi or
network worms. Three boards (Open Seas free-roam with growth pads; Honeycomb
Cove, the classic no-objective arena on a honeycomb sea floor; Black Pearl
Relay with twin capstan objectives), three room paces (Harbor, Classic,
Tempest), friend rooms via shared codes, mouse-wheel/pinch camera zoom with a
fairness cap, stacking x2-x10 treasure multiplier tokens (each pickup adds
time to its tier's clock, no cap; overlapping tiers multiply; shown as gold
chips at the top of the screen), sprint costs 4 size/second at 2.0x speed and
drops the spent size as collectable wake loot. Design law: nothing appears
from nowhere - killed crews drop their conserved mass where they fell.

## Play
- [Founding 50 external test](https://wormifi.com/founding-50.html?utm_source=llms&utm_medium=machine_discovery&utm_campaign=founding_50&utm_id=llms): play one run, host a free private room, or invite one friend
- [Play Wormifi](https://wormifi.com/): the game itself, playable instantly
- [Install on any phone](https://wormifi.com/install.html): Android package or iPhone home screen, no app store
